whatIs.a: A debit card that allows you to spend your crypto balance directly.

howWorks.a: It connects to your wallet and instantly converts crypto to fiat at the point of sale.

cryptoSupported.a: We support major assets including BTC, ETH, and stablecoins.

walletsSupported.a: Trust Wallet and other major Web3 wallets via WalletConnect.

countriesSupported.a: The card is available in over 100 countries globally.

cardFees.a: Zero annual fees for virtual and standard physical cards.

howRewardsWork.a: Earn up to 5% back on all purchases, paid in the crypto of your choice.

applePay.a: Yes, our cards are fully compatible with Apple Pay.

googlePay.a: Yes, our cards are fully compatible with Google Pay.

availability.q: Is the card available in my country?
availability.a: Check the app for real-time availability in your region.

howToGet.q: How do I get a card?
howToGet.a: Simply apply through the Trust Wallet app or our website.

afterActivation.a: You can start spending immediately with the virtual card.
